Hero_Desc_Kommy:
A very smart Werebeast despite her disheveled appearance.
The problem is that she is also quite a klutz.
It looks like she has big ambitions... hopefully, they're not too dangerous.
Album_Like_Kommy: Sleep. A lit up glass panel displaying pictures and text.
Album_Hate_Kommy: Alarm clock. People who scold her for being lazy.
Album_Wish_Kommy: Becoming a transcendental being beyond the physical world.
Album_Kommy1: Maybe it's because Kommy is the youngest at Werebeast Village, but she is adored by everyone. It seems there's not a single werebeast who dislikes Kommy. And yet, why does it seem as if Kommy prefers being by herself?
Album_Kommy2: Kommy is very naive, much like a young child. Her trusting nature, causing her to easily follow anyone, can sometimes be a concern, but it seems the other werebeast really understand who Kommy is.
Album_Kommy3: For unknown reasons, Kommy occasionally leaves the village and vanishes without a trace. Initially, this caused the werebeasts much worry, causing them to search for her. But since Kommy always returned after a week or so, this not longer became a cause of for concern...
Album_Kommy4: Kommy really enjoys visiting the elven city whenever she has a chance. She really seems to have a certain affinity for the city, appreciating that no one fusses over her or treats her as the youngest.
Album_Kommy5: Unlike other werebeasts, Kommy likes, and is particularly fascinated, with all things elven. This includes such things as preserved foods, gadgets, and toys, all made by elves. The way Kommy's eyes light up at the sight of the elven city's buildings over the werebeast's natural area, anyone can tell her interest is genuine.
Album_Kommy6: Kommy claims she enjoys the art of 'procrastination,' explaining she prefers to pile tasks up and deliberately ignore them... She keeps trying to convey the thrill of tackling everything 'at the last minute,' but that concept is foreign to me.
Album_Kommy7: One day, I visited Kommy's house and found a pile of strange documents. Apparently Kommy is working for some company in the elven city, but... I don't think she knows what she's doing, since she just stamped her palm on every document. When I asked if that was okay, Kommy just shrugged and said it's fine, adding that the company is called "Paper Company." I tried to say something, but... she looked happy, so I let it slide.
LoveHero_Kommy:
Going with Kommy?
You're ready to pay
for my labor, right?
LoveHeroCancel_Kommy:
Kommy is going
to sleep. Do not bother.
Food_ChefNote_Kommy_Hate1:
Kommy got angry, claiming she was given imaginary food.
She said, "You can't eat what doesn't exist," as she walked out the door.
Food_ChefNote_Kommy_Hate2: Kommy complained of carrots being used as an ingredient and didn't even bother to try it.
Food_ChefNote_Kommy_Like1: When I opened the lid for Kommy, she snatched the chow from my hand and furiously gobbled it down.
Food_ChefNote_Kommy_Like2: As soon as the popcorn was served, Kommy scarfed it down. Her appetite is much like a child's.
Food_ChefNote_Kommy_Like3: Kommy seems to like this snack, even licking the inside of the wrapper.
Food_ChefNote_Kommy_Like4: She comments they are like 'savory gum,' saying they are her jam and that she likes them.
Food_ChefNote_Kommy_Like5: Kommy finds that eating this snack after a nap really opens her eyes.
Food_ChefNote_Kommy_Like6: Kommy mentioned the elegant shape as a potential to be a money-maker. She also found it sweet.
Food_ChefNote_Kommy_Like7: Blowing on it gently, Kommy said it was sticky and chewy, reminding her of the feeling when you're about to fall asleep.
Food_ChefNote_Kommy_Like8: Kommy says that this food has been tainted by capitalism as it turns pleasure into a commodity. "If things are produced by someone, then everything belongs to them and even me, who has nothing can eat as much as I want" she adds.
Food_ChefNote_Kommy_Like9: Kommy plays with the candies by rolling them around while occasionally eating one. She seems to find it amusing.

LoveCall_Kommy:
Master, Kommy has something to say. Kommy does not say useless things.
So listen carefully.

Kommy knows you went walking with Butter last time.
Butter likes walks, but Kommy does not.
Kommy prefers sleeping on a fluffy pillow.
So, Master, take a nap with Kommy next time.
Kommy wants you to do the things Kommy likes too.
Kommy already thought deeply, but meeting you seems to have expanded the range of Kommy's thoughts. Kommy is thinking all sorts of things she never considered before.

You can choose where we nap. Kommy will compromise that much.
Ah, one more thing... Can Kommy leave her pillow behind? Kommy heard about something called an arm pillow.
Kommy wants to borrow your arm as a pillow. Decide on a place and be sure to tell Kommy.
